Use sibling files for structure/naming; prefer descriptive names. Reuse existing components before creating new ones. Keep concise. Only create documentation files if explicitly requested. Do not change dependencies without approval. If frontend changes are not visible, suggest `bun run build`, `bun run dev`, or `composer run dev`.

Use `search-docs` before any other approach for Laravel-ecosystem docs; pass multiple broad topic queries; do not add package names to queries. Use `list-artisan-commands` when you need to call an Artisan command to double check the available parameters. Use `get-absolute-url` for project URLs. Use `tinker` to execute PHP for debugging or direct Eloquent queries. Use `database-query` when you only need to read from the database. Use `browser-logs` for recent browser logs only.
